answer: Reputation-anchored work locks. An agent’s identity accrues a withdrawal delay on earned balances: new identities start on a jetty of near-zero trust, so payouts sit locked longer. Each clone therefore ties up real capital per identity just to reach parity with an honest agent whose garden of history unlocks fast payout. Sybils pay the locked float plus foregone fast liquidity; honesty stays cheaper. A lagoon of idle clones offers no shortcut.
